scope: Static package audit for the selected ten archive outputs. No gameplay or browser QA was performed.

method.artifactChecks: Compared each source-manifest file against on-disk presence, byte size, and SHA-256; reconciled file counts and artifact byte totals.
method.referenceChecks: Compared the current entry HTML and runtime bootstrap with packaged files; checked identity/hash/size against each source-manifest file; ran the read-only runtime gate for C2/C3 project data, Cocos bundles, Unity payloads, Lime packed libraries, Fireboy dynamic theme assets, bridge integrity, and local entry references. Unknown runtimes remain needs-review; no gameplay/browser QA was performed.
method.encoding: Pinned output records use identity wire/artifact encoding. Level Devil’s Lime pack has a 15-byte lime-asset-pack header followed by gzip data. Burrito Bison Unity .unityweb payloads retain gzip magic for the Unity loader. HTTP Content-Encoding headers were not verified.
method.httpHeaders: Not verified. A bounded localhost request was refused by the local dev listener, so Content-Type and Content-Encoding response headers remain unconfirmed.
method.gameplayQA: Not performed; left to the user per recovery instructions.
method.guestAdapterCheck: Geometry Dash Hyper Wave’s local Sidequest guest/offline adapter was checked in a deterministic Node VM for bootReady, explicit unsupported callbacks, false publisher/account availability, a visible guest label, and absence of rewardReceived.

batchIntegrity.note: These checks establish integrity of files that were packaged, including the documented Hyper Wave local adapter overlay. They do not establish that optional or undiscovered runtime dependencies are complete or that gameplay works.

blockingIssues: The entry config declares a Unity 2020.3.37f1 build with cached decompressed payloads of about 33 MB. The package has only 105,621 artifact bytes and omits FunnyShooter2_Poki.data.unityweb, framework.js.unityweb, loader.js, wasm.unityweb, and the configured game JPEG; the manifest records 404s for these paths. master-loader.js and unity-2020.js alone are only loaders, not the game runtime payload.
packages.action: Recover and hash-pin the Unity data, framework, loader, wasm, and referenced image files before integration.
Static package is suitable for user gameplay QA; retain the existing archive CSP and do not claim gameplay verified.
nonBlockingIssues: Construct 3 runtime, project data.json, worker/runtime dependencies, and all 26 statically referenced project assets are present and hash-verified.
Only appmanifest.json and icons/icon-128.png entry references are absent; these are PWA/icon assets, not project runtime dependencies.

packages.action: Static package is suitable for user gameplay QA; retain archive CSP and keep multiplayer/backend behavior unverified.
nonBlockingIssues: Construct 3 runtime and data.json are present; all 25 asset paths in project data resolve. The game config sets useWorker=false, so the absent optional workermain.js is not required.
PWA icons, service worker, optional event scripts, and optional audio helpers have source 404 warnings; these are not required by the configured core path.
index.html references manifest.json and ../favicon.png, neither is packaged; these are PWA/icon references.
The packaged Latin PT Sans WOFF2 file is a 97-byte plain-text 'No Content' placeholder, and the other font slices return 404; expect fallback typography until valid font files are pinned.
The loader includes Google/Input Tools references that the archive CSP will block. No external calls were enabled or bypassed; gameplay/network behavior still needs the user's manual QA.
packages.action: For a polished package, repair the font references and either add manifest/icon files or remove only the non-core references after review. Preserve the archive CSP.

blockingIssues: Cocos settings set hasResourcesBundle=true and launchScene=db://assets/loadBundle.fire, but no game resources bundle, scene, or bundle manifest is packaged. The engine scripts and settings alone are not the game content.
packages.action: Recover and pin the Cocos resources bundle and launch scene before integration. Physics references are conditional, not the primary blocker.

nonBlockingIssues: The Fancade shell references ancillary common/view files and sound assets that returned 404; the packaged index.wasm and index.data game payloads are present.
packages.action: Static package is suitable for user gameplay QA. Check the archive host serves index.wasm as application/wasm and the data file without an incorrect Content-Encoding before promotion.

nonBlockingIssues: The GameMaker core and three texture atlases are packaged and hash-verified. The original YaGames extension was replaced at its existing local extension path by a visibly labeled Sidequest guest/offline adapter; the upstream sourceSha256/sourceSize and wire hashes remain preserved.

Deterministic VM callbacks show local bootReady=true, publisher/account/leaderboard/ad/reward availability=false, explicit adError/rewardError/playerInitError/leaderboardsInitError responses, and no rewardReceived event. No publisher SDK, account, ads, or rewards are emulated.
packages.action: Use as a guest/offline static QA candidate; test gameplay manually and describe online services as unavailable.

nonBlockingIssues: GameMaker runtime and both texture atlases are packaged. The Poki adapter is included as a file but not referenced by the entry HTML; the inline bootstrap falls back to GameMaker_Init when PokiSDK is unavailable. Publisher services remain blocked by archive CSP.
packages.action: Static package is suitable for user gameplay QA; keep publisher services blocked and do not claim gameplay verified.

packages.runtimeCore: present with required Lime packed assets
packages.action: Static package is suitable for user gameplay QA; verify the archive serves the packed library bytes unchanged and do not claim gameplay verified.
nonBlockingIssues: The compiled OpenFL/Lime code names lib/default.pak with gzip packing. The 3.82 MB pack is present and its 15-byte lime-asset-pack header followed by gzip magic was verified; package and bridge hashes match.

The bundle contains the START/MIDDLE/FINISH level JSON modules inline; the 115 missing level-JSON URLs reported by the broad static scanner are bundled module names, not absent files required by the loader.
26 seasonal shop, character thumbnail, popup, and shadow images returned 404; core bundle and startup assets are present, but those cosmetics may display missing-image placeholders.
Poki/ad/social endpoints are external and remain blocked by archive CSP.
packages.action: Static package is suitable for user gameplay QA. Confirm missing cosmetic images fail gracefully; keep external publisher services blocked.

releaseReadiness: No package is declared playable or production-ready by this audit. The candidate list means asset-level static integration and user QA can proceed; it does not record successful gameplay or HTTP-header, WebGL, account, or SDK QA.
